question: India creates space history as Shubhanshu Shukla becomes 1st Indian to set foot on ISS. Shubhanshu Shukla hails from which place?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India creates space history as Shubhanshu Shukla becomes 1st Indian to set foot on ISS.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India created history** as **IAF Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla** flew to **space** aboard **SpaceX's Dragon spacecraft** under the **Axiom-4 mission**.

 
 
• 
 
The spacecraft **docked with the International Space Station (ISS).**

 
 
• 
 
**Shukla** is the **second Indian in space**, after **Rakesh Sharma (1984)**—a gap of **41 years**.

 
 
• 
 
Shukla is **born in Lucknow**, Uttar Pradesh.

 
 
• 
 
**Axiom-4 crew** includes astronauts from the **US, India, Poland, and Hungary**.

 
 
• 
 
Mission duration: **14-day scientific expedition** in **Low Earth Orbit (LEO)**.

 
 
• 
 
Docked with **Harmony module’s space-facing port** on the ISS.

 
 
• 
 
**Experiments focus** on **space nutrition and food sustainability**, using **edible microalgae**.

 
 
• 
 
The research is supported by **ISRO**, **DBT**, and **NASA**.

 
 
• 
 
Goals: Understand **microgravity** and **space radiation** impacts, and enable **long-duration space travel** with **sustainable life-support systems**.
